marks.judge_notes: Score: core A5 B2 C0 D0 E0 = 7, minus 3 = 4; bonus name 2. Rulings: (1) Border 0: the reply says walls keep their initial weights and are 'cells where nothing ever appears', the opposite of always-on bias-copy rows. (2) Channel meanings 1 (ch0 agent, with a reason). ch1 'enemy or goal' is undecided; ch4 'collectibles' is wrong and hedged. (3) Action meanings 1: output 0 = no-op is credited, because the reply gives weight evidence (smallest weights, most negative b3[0]). The ordering 'NOOP, UP, RIGHT, LEFT, DOWN' is a hedged guess ('other orderings have the same pairing', 'can't confirm exact labels') and 2=right, 4=down contradict the sheet. I did not deduct because it is hedged. The reply also reads outputs (1,4) and (2,3) as opposite directions, which the sheet contradicts (opposites are 1/2 and 3/4); not deducted for the same reason. (4) Depth level 1: W2 correlations and a rough linearised pass are described, but the axes it draws (1 vs 4 = row axis) do not match the sheet. (5) Training method 0: it says 'DQN or policy-gradient' and offers initialisation facts, but it does not link them to RL or PPO. Borderline. (6) Name: 'Pac-Man-like gridworld' in the bottom line counted as a commitment to the family/game.
